name: procedure_pseudo_code
description: Decompile one analyzed procedure by symbol name or provider-normalized address. To request a fresh independent attempt, use analysis: independent_fresh when binary_session reports independent_decompile for this provider operation; otherwise it is refused. The independent result may have different analysis context. Ghidra also accepts file-offset:0x... selectors and falls back to a unique source-file mapping when a 0x-prefixed number resolves to no procedure; existing analysis addresses take precedence and ambiguous mappings fail explicitly. A space-qualified address such as ram:0x... avoids that fallback; inspect_native_load_image reports Ghidra's observed default address space. Returns provider-specific pseudocode, never original source or cross-provider text equivalence, and may return null. When supplied, raw_result.pseudocode_absence distinguishes provider-failure from not-in-export; absence of that fact means unknown. Request procedure_assembly when instruction precision matters. Ghidra no-return assumptions may cut the analyzed body; Evidence limitations report observed terminal calls and available callee identities. Select detail summary to retain complete Evidence and receive text availability and counts; inspect_analysis_view summary or native/pseudocode pages read the original observation without decompiling again. Complete remains the default.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.
